narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video features a dermatologist sharing her professional experience speaking in Korea about advanced skin treatments. She uses this story to establish her expertise and clarify the difference between standard beauty maintenance and medical treatments for acne and pores, ultimately directing viewers to her clinic.
